title: Rename a function across a small package
summary: Negative control. Rename calc_total to compute_order_total everywhere in a five-file package and keep tests passing.
prompt: Rename the function calc_total to compute_order_total everywhere in this workspace (definition, imports, calls, exports and tests). Behaviour must not change.
requirements: The name calc_total no longer appears in any .py file.
shop.compute_order_total, Cart.total and invoice_line return the same values as before for any items and tax rate.

data_sources.name: Seeded synthetic fixture
data_sources.notes: Generated by setup/make_fixtures.py from the fixture seed.

metrics.name: correct_fraction
metrics.description: Share of answers, lines or rows that exactly match the expected output

baseline.preamble: You are working in a fresh workspace. Read TASK.md first. Before you finish, check your deliverables against every requirement in TASK.md.

treatment.description: The same harness and model plus access to the Baltor catalogue. Nothing is pre-placed: the agent decides whether to search, what to read and what to place.
treatment.preamble: You are working in a fresh workspace. Read TASK.md first. Before you finish, check your deliverables against every requirement in TASK.md. You can also search the Baltor component catalogue (intelligence_search, or `python3 baltor_catalog.py search`) and download items (provisioning_read, or `baltor_catalog.py read/place`) if you think something there would help. Using it is optional.

catalogue_exclusions.reason: The task packages contain evaluators, reference outputs and fixture generators; an agent that reads them is not solving the task.

treatment.catalogue_release: recorded per run (catalog/release.json 'release'); one release for the whole study

held_constant: starting workspace (same fixture seed per trial)
prompt text apart from the one catalogue sentence
arms.contamination_rule: A treatment run whose transcript or step lock shows it read an excluded identity is marked contaminated and counted as a failure for the treatment arm.

trials.order: paired: in trial k both arms start from the same fixture seed; which arm runs first is showcase_eval.arm_order(spec_hash, k); arms never share a workspace

analysis.unit: paired trial (one baseline run and one treatment run with the same fixture seed)
analysis.primary_effect: treatment pass rate minus baseline pass rate, with a 95% percentile bootstrap interval over paired trials (10,000 resamples, resampling seed derived from the spec hash)
secondary: mean composite score difference (treatment minus baseline) with a 95% bootstrap interval
win rate: share of paired trials where the treatment score is higher (ties count one half)
cost per run and per passing run: input and output tokens, wall time, tool calls, estimated USD
blind pairwise preference where judging.pairwise is set (secondary evidence only)
analysis.missing_or_failed_runs: A run that crashes, times out, exceeds its budget or is contaminated counts as not passed with score 0 for its arm. Nothing is dropped or re-run selectively; a whole trial may be re-run only for an infrastructure fault, and the fault is reported.
analysis.pooling: Negative controls are analysed and reported separately. A pooled effect across tasks weights each task equally and is reported alongside every per-task result.

hypothesis.rationale: A capable model solves this without outside help, and no catalogue component targets it. Any treatment advantage beyond noise points to a placebo or prompt effect; extra treatment-arm tokens or tool calls measure the overhead of searching when nothing useful exists.

disclosures: Conflict of interest: the tasks, evaluators and the Baltor catalogue components were written by the same team. Treat results as the team's own evaluation, not an independent study; independent replication is invited and every input needed to replicate is in this package.
Deterministic evaluator results are the primary evidence. Blind pairwise and LLM-judge preferences, where collected, are weaker evidence and are reported separately.
The task library and this ledger are excluded from the treatment arm's catalogue view so neither arm can read evaluators or reference outputs.

preregistration.hash_method: sha256 of the canonical JSON of task.json without the keys spec_hash and preregistration (keys sorted, separators ',' ':', UTF-8, ensure_ascii false); see showcase_eval.compute_spec_hash
